 Home News General Apple outage: Apple Store, Pay, iCloud, Support, Music and more services down, what company said
 By Vikas Yadav | Updated on 17-Nov-2026 Add Digit as a 
preferred source Follow Us Highlights Apple Outage: Apple services, including Support, App Store, iCloud, Apple Pay and Music, are facing outages in the US.
 Apple Support and Apple Pay outage numbers crossed over 2,300 mark each.
 iCloud outage figures has crossed 1,300 reports, while the App Store has recorded around 950 reports.
 Apple Down: Apple Support, iCloud, Apple Pay, App Store, Music, and more apps and services of the iPhone maker are facing disruptions in the United States. In the case of Apple Support and Apple Pay, the disruption reports have crossed the 2,300 mark. In the case of iCloud, the company's online storage service, the disruption figures crossed 1,300 at 11:05 PM IST. Around 950 reports of problems in the App Store, the iPhone maker's rival to Google's Play Store, were reported.
 The Cupertino-based tech giant has confirmed an outage on apps such as Apple App Store, Apple Music and Apple Care on Device among other products and said these services "may be slow or unavailable".
